page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.s3.medium is an x86_64 architecture virtual machine instance belonging to the ecs.s3 server family. It is configured with 4 vCPUs mapped to 4 physical cores with a single thread per core, utilizing dedicated CPU allocation under the KVM hypervisor. The instance is equipped with 4.0 GB of system memory, resulting in a resource density of 1.0 GB of RAM per core. It does not include local storage or bundled GPU hardware, requiring external block storage for operating system and application deployment.

This instance is designed for workloads requiring dedicated CPU resources but with minimal memory requirements. The 1:1 ratio of vCPUs to memory makes it suitable for compute-heavy tasks that do not maintain large in-memory datasets. Common deployments include lightweight web servers, distributed compute nodes, and basic batch processing tasks. Because it lacks local storage and integrated graphics processing units, it is not intended for database hosting or GPU-accelerated workloads.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.s3.medium is an x86_64 virtual machine instance from the ecs.s3 family, featuring 4 dedicated vCPUs across 4 physical cores and 4.0 GB of RAM. Operating on the KVM hypervisor, this server provides a 1:1 ratio of memory to vCPUs without hyperthreading. It contains no local storage or GPU accelerators, meaning all storage must be provisioned externally. The dedicated CPU allocation ensures consistent processing performance, making it a cost-efficient option for compute-focused workloads with low memory footprints, such as lightweight web serving, batch processing, and distributed computing nodes.
